title: Demo autopilot policy (port-reserve, relay chains, mesh BFS) lives in core/testkit.odin, whose header falsely claims 'NOT used by the game'
evidence:
core/testkit.odin:3: "// testkit.odin — harness/test tooling (NOT used by the game). The demo"
app/run/autopilot.odin:16: "	pp.testkit_wire_boot(rc.state, rc.state.tick)"
app/run/autopilot.odin:27: "	pp.testkit_autowire(rc.state, rc.state.tick, &rc.autopilot_wired)"
detail: The pure-sim core package (ODN-1) ships ~130 lines of app-side demo-AI policy (house port-reserve min_free=2, midpoint relay placement, reachable-junction mesh BFS) under a 'testkit' name. The production autopilot calls it, so the header is stale and core is coupled to demo behavior.
recommended_fix: Move testkit_wire_boot/testkit_autowire into app/run/ (demo policy is an app-layer concern); core stays pure sim. Rewrite the stale 'NOT used by the game' header once it actually is test-only.

title: App.autopilot_wired field is declared but never made/read/freed — the live state is Run_Context.autopilot_wired
evidence:
app/main.odin:37 (App struct): "	autopilot_wired: map[u32]bool,"
app/run/run.odin:49 (Run_Context struct, the live one): "	autopilot_wired: map[u32]bool,"
detail: The App struct field is never initialized, read, or deleted anywhere in app/ (verified by repo-wide grep). The autopilot operates exclusively on rc.autopilot_wired. Dead field — an uninitialized map waiting to trap a future reader.
recommended_fix: Delete the autopilot_wired field from the App struct in app/main.odin. Run_Context.autopilot_wired is the sole live copy.

title: App.cosmetic_rng is seeded at boot but never consumed — the ODN-15 cosmetic stream is dead state
evidence:
app/main.odin:42: "	cosmetic_rng: pp.Rng, // ODN-15 - cosmetics only, never the sim's"
app/main.odin:67: "	pp.rng_seed(&app.cosmetic_rng, fresh_seed() ~ 0xC05E)"
detail: cosmetic_rng is seeded once but no rng_next/rng_range call ever reads it (verified: only the declaration and the seed appear repo-wide). The prototype's stings are deterministic (synth_sting), so the dedicated cosmetic stream is unused dead state.
recommended_fix: Either wire cosmetic_rng into sting/click variant selection (its ODN-15 purpose) or drop the field and seed until audio variants actually exist.

title: App_Mode (a presentation FSM enum) is defined in core/types.odin but core never uses it — only app re-aliases it
evidence:
core/types.odin:58: "App_Mode :: enum u8 { Boot, Menu, Run, Paused, Game_Over }"
app/run/autopilot.odin:10: "App_Mode :: pp.App_Mode"
detail: App_Mode is a UI/orchestration-layer concept (Boot/Menu/Run/Paused/Game_Over) that core neither branches on nor uses (verified: zero references in core non-test files or harness). It leaks a presentation-layer type into the pure-sim core package (ODN-1).
recommended_fix: Move the App_Mode enum to app/run/ (or app/main); core should not export presentation modes it does not act on.
